QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_19

question.text: Under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, a Cat III AIF scheme must have a minimum corpus of:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Minimum corpus of any AIF scheme is INR 20 crore (CTR row on Minimum Corpus). This is uniform across Cat I/II/III categories. **The Trap:** 10, 50, 100 cr are fictional lower/higher thresholds. The 20 cr rule is uniform. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C / XIX-D test the same 20 cr rule. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** A 20 cr corpus doesn't mean you can operate profitably — Cat III audit + prime-broker + valuer + admin cost typically requires 100+ cr to be viable. Regulatory minimum ≠ commercial floor.
